verses.original: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaḵ·mō·wṯ nā·šîm bā·nə·ṯāh ḇê·ṯāh wə·’iw·we·leṯ bə·yā·ḏe·hā ṯe·her·sen·nū
verses.literal: Every wise woman builds her house but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ bə·yā·šə·rōw yə·rê Yah·weh ū·nə·lō·wz də·rā·ḵāw bō·w·zê·hū
verses.literal: He who walks in uprightness fears the LORD but the one who is devious in his ways despises Him

verses.original: בְּֽפִי־ אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄î- ’ĕ·wîl ḥō·ṭer ga·’ă·wāh wə·śip̄·ṯê ḥă·ḵā·mîm tiš·mū·rêm
verses.literal: The proud speech of a fool brings a rod to his back but the lips of the wise protect them

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְרָב־ תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּכֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’ê·ḇūs bār wə·rāḇ- tə·ḇū·’ō·wṯ bə·ḵō·aḥ šō·wr
verses.literal: Where there are no oxen the manger is empty but an abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox

verses.original: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ ’ĕ·mū·nîm lō yə·ḵaz·zêḇ wə·yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm ‘êḏ šā·qer
verses.literal: An honest witness does not deceive but a dishonest witness pours forth lies

verses.original: בִּקֶּשׁ־ לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: biq·qeš- lêṣ ḥāḵ·māh wā·’ā·yin wə·ḏa·‘aṯ lə·nā·ḇō·wn nā·qāl
verses.literal: A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none but knowledge comes easily to the discerning

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל־ יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ min·ne·ḡeḏ lə·’îš kə·sîl ū·ḇal- yā·ḏa‘·tā śip̄·ṯê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Stay away from a foolish man you will gain no knowledge from his speech

verses.original: חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵə·maṯ ‘ā·rūm hā·ḇîn dar·kōw wə·’iw·we·leṯ kə·sî·lîm mir·māh
verses.literal: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way but the folly of fools deceives them

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·wi·lîm yā·lîṣ ’ā·šām ū·ḇên yə·šā·rîm rā·ṣō·wn
verses.literal: Fools mock the making of amends but goodwill is found among the upright

verses.original: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא־ יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ yō·w·ḏê·a‘ mār·raṯ nap̄·šōw ū·ḇə·śim·ḥā·ṯōw lō- yiṯ·‘ā·raḇ zār
verses.literal: The heart knows its own bitterness and no stranger shares in its joy

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ rə·šā·‘îm yiš·šā·mêḏ wə·’ō·hel yə·šā·rîm yap̄·rî·aḥ
verses.literal: The house of the wicked will be destroyed but the tent of the upright will flourish

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: yêš de·reḵ yā·šār lip̄·nê- ’îš wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh dar·ḵê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: There is a way that seems right to a man but its end is the way of death

verses.original: גַּם־ בִּשְׂח֥וֹק יִכְאַב־ לֵ֑ב וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- biś·ḥō·wq yiḵ·’aḇ- lêḇ wə·ʾa·ḥă·rī·ṯå̄h śim·ḥāh ṯū·ḡāh
verses.literal: Even in laughter the heart may ache and joy may end in sorrow

verses.original: מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: mid·də·rā·ḵāw yiś·ba‘ sūḡ lêḇ ū·mê·‘ā·lāw ’îš ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways but a good man is rewarded for his ways

verses.original: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכָל־ דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pe·ṯî ya·’ă·mîn lə·ḵāl dā·ḇār wə·‘ā·rūm yā·ḇîn la·’ă·šu·rōw
verses.literal: The simple man believes every word but the prudent man watches his steps

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām yā·rê wə·sār mê·rā‘ ū·ḵə·sîl miṯ·‘ab·bêr ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ
verses.literal: A wise man fears and turns from evil but a fool is careless and reckless

verses.original: קְֽצַר־ אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְאִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ṣar- ’ap·pa·yim ya·‘ă·śeh ’iw·we·leṯ wə·’îš mə·zim·mō·wṯ yiś·śā·nê
verses.literal: A quick-tempered man . . . acts foolishly and a devious man is hated

verses.original: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥă·lū p̄ə·ṯā·yim ’iw·we·leṯ wa·‘ă·rū·mîm yaḵ·ti·rū ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: The simple inherit folly but the prudent are crowned with knowledge

verses.original: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל־ שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: ša·ḥū rā·‘îm lip̄·nê ṭō·w·ḇîm ū·rə·šā·‘îm ‘al- ša·‘ă·rê ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: The evil bow before the good and the wicked at the gates of the righteous

verses.original: גַּם־ לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam- lə·rê·‘ê·hū yiś·śā·nê rāš wə·’ō·hă·ḇê ‘ā·šîr rab·bîm
verses.literal: The poor man is hated even by his neighbor but many are those who love the rich

verses.original: בָּז־ לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן עֲנָיִים אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bāz- lə·rê·‘ê·hū ḥō·w·ṭê ū·mə·ḥō·w·nên ʿă·nå̄·yīm ’aš·rāw
verses.literal: He who despises his neighbor sins but blessed is he who shows kindness to the poor

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽלוֹא־ יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: hălō·w- yiṯ·‘ū ḥō·rə·šê rā‘ wə·ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ḥō·rə·šê ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Do not those who contrive evil go astray But those who plan goodness find loving devotion and faithfulness

verses.original: בְּכָל־ עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר־ שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl ‘e·ṣeḇ yih·yeh mō·w·ṯār ū·ḏə·ḇa·rś- śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim ’aḵ- lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: There is profit in all labor but mere talk . . . leads only to poverty

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ḥă·ḵā·mîm ‘ā·šə·rām ’iw·we·leṯ kə·sî·lîm ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: The crown of the wise is their wealth but the effort of fools is folly

verses.original: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·ṣîl nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ ‘êḏ ’ĕ·meṯ wə·yā·p̄i·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm mir·māh
verses.literal: A truthful witness saves lives but one who utters lies is deceitful

verses.original: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח־ עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh miḇ·ṭaḥ- ‘ōz ū·lə·ḇā·nāw yih·yeh maḥ·seh
verses.literal: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence and his children shall have a place of refuge

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm lā·sūr mim·mō·qə·šê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life turning a man from the snares of death

verses.original: בְּרָב־ עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rāḇ- ‘ām haḏ·raṯ- me·leḵ ū·ḇə·’e·p̄es lə·’ōm mə·ḥit·taṯ rā·zō·wn
verses.literal: A large population is a king’s splendor but a lack of subjects is a prince’s ruin

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב־ תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר־ ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim raḇ- tə·ḇū·nāh ū·qə·ṣar- rū·aḥ mê·rîm ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: A patient man . . . has great understanding but a quick-tempered man . . . promotes folly

verses.original: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yê ḇə·śā·rîm lêḇ mar·pê ū·rə·qaḇ ‘ă·ṣā·mō·wṯ qin·’āh
verses.literal: A tranquil heart is life to the body but envy rots the bones

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק־ דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ʿō·šēq- dāl ḥê·rêp̄ ‘ō·śê·hū ū·mə·ḵab·bə·ḏōw ḥō·nên ’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him

verses.original: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw yid·dā·ḥeh rā·šā‘ wə·ḥō·seh ḇə·mō·w·ṯōw ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin but the righteous man has a refuge even in death

verses.original: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·lêḇ nā·ḇō·wn tā·nū·aḥ ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḇə·qe·reḇ kə·sî·lîm tiw·wā·ḏê·a‘
verses.literal: Wisdom rests in the heart of the discerning even among fools she is known

verses.original: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם־ גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·ḏā·qāh ṯə·rō·w·mêm- gō·w wə·ḥe·seḏ lə·’um·mîm ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Righteousness exalts a nation but sin is a disgrace to any people

verses.original: רְֽצוֹן־ מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ṣō·wn- me·leḵ lə·‘e·ḇeḏ maś·kîl wə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw tih·yeh mê·ḇîš
verses.literal: A king delights in a wise servant but his anger falls on the shameful
